name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability, a behavior change, or a configuration surface change
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

<!-- Security vulnerability? Do not open an issue. Follow docs/opensource/SECURITY.md. -->

## Problem statement

What are you trying to do, and what blocks you today? Describe the use case, not
only the missing API.

## Proposed solution

The change you have in mind: behavior, configuration surface, data format, or
deployment topology. Say what "done" looks like.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, workarounds, or upstream projects you evaluated, and why you
prefer the proposal above. Note trade-offs you already see.

## Additional context

Links, prior discussions, related issues, or a sketch. If this needs a new
dependency or container image, name it and its license: that is a licensing
decision and must land in `NOTICE` with the change.

> Behavior, configuration, data-format, and topology changes need an issue before
> a pull request. See docs/opensource/CONTRIBUTING.md, sections 2 and 7.
